layer.$description: Stacking order (z-index). Popovers use the top layer and need no token.

below.$description: Stacking step below the page's content (z-index -1).

backdrop.$description: The page backdrop: behind all content.

raised.$description: Above a sibling overlay in the same component (Card's children).

overlay.$description: Revealed overlays that must sit above sticky chrome (skip link).
